definition: to cause someone to be surprised
description: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.

taps.phrase: to step out of a car

de.answer: Er überrascht sie mit einem riesigen Blumenstrauß.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: La está sorprendiendo con un ramo enorme.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il la surprend avec un énorme bouquet.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
